title: Charred Russian Pasta With Morbier Crust
description: A rich and savory pasta dish with a nutty twist, featuring a crunchy morbier crust. Perfect for a dinner party or special occasion.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a separate pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add charred garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add russian (dried dill) and cook for another minute.
Combine cooked pasta, nutty (nutritional yeast), and russian (dried dill) mixture.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish.
Crumbly morbier crust: in a bowl, mix together morbier and a pinch of salt.
Top the pasta mixture with the morbier crust.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-15 minutes, until crust is golden brown.
Optional: garnish with chopped fresh herbs or grated morbier for added flavor and texture
